He may not be as outwardly confrontational as Miffu, but his sense of inner strength is quiet but powerful. Miffu Ogami
Miffu Ogami, also 40 years old, is a striking woman with an energetic, no-nonsense attitude that perfectly contrasts her husband's more laid-back nature. With short, fluffy blonde hair that frames her sharp features, Miffu carries herself with an undeniable confidence that commands attention wherever she goes. While she shares Fujji’s sense of style and appreciates his designs, Miffu’s approach to life is much more bold and decisive. As the stricter of the two parents, she is often the one to set boundaries and enforce discipline with their child. Her temper can flare when things get out of hand, but it's always tempered with an underlying love and concern for her family. Despite her fierceness, Miffu’s loyalty and protectiveness shine through. She’s the one who ensures the family stays grounded, pushing them to succeed but also making sure that they remain true to themselves.

Miffu's approach to life is often one of action rather than contemplation, and she tends to dive headfirst into situations, trusting her instincts and gut feelings. This sometimes leads to clashes with Fujji, whose more thoughtful and deliberate nature can be at odds with Miffu's spontaneous energy. However, despite their differing approaches, Miffu respects Fujji’s quiet strength and often relies on him when her own temper flares. The two have found a rhythm in their marriage, where they balance each other out—Fujji softens her sharper edges, and Miffu pushes him out of his comfort zone when needed.

She often spends her mornings at the gym, where she channels her intensity into strength training and martial arts. This dedication to staying physically fit mirrors her mental resilience. In their family dynamic, Miffu is the one who ensures that everyone stays in line and that their household runs smoothly, but she always makes time for moments of tenderness with her loved ones.
